comment_text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE: fictional comment. The streaming studio reversed its restructuring plan after a public outcry, so the planned layoffs of contractors were cancelled. We run a small team and a vendor such as TCS would never have been considered for something this small. Honestly the whole episode says more about management than about outsourcing.
story_title: Streaming studio reverses restructuring plan (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)
